title: Migration of Statistical Data Systems to Cloud Infrastructure

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Migrate twelve on-premise statistical applications to AWS or Azure. Implement backup, monitoring, identity management and disaster recovery. Transfer knowledge to in-house staff and support operations for one year.
